notes.title: Cureocity Version 1.1.0 has now been released!
notes.notes:
Cureocity Version 1.1.0 has now been released!

Dear adventurers,

Since our journey began, your invaluable insights and suggestions have shaped the world of Hosbitome. Inspired by your feedback, we are thrilled to introduce a suite of enhancements designed to enrich your adventures even further.

What's New in Version 1.1.0

1. Recording System Optimizations

Your adventure in Hosbitome will be recorded and spread!

In Version 1.1.0, the game will keep a record of what you do to monsters in each level, and it will not be automatically reset when you finish or restart the game.

You can choose to load this record at any time from the main interface to check your current handling status of the monsters and select the corresponding level to alter your approach, thus allowing you to explore different storylines.

You can also clear the record of your choices in the archive interface. Please note that by doing so, your play history in the game will be reset.  While it does not affect your earned achievements, you will no longer be able to skip levels you have previously completed.

2. Expanded Level Skipping Options

Practice makes perfect. The legendary adventurer can have an easy win. 

In Version 1.1.0, you can skip the levels that you have previously completed. When replaying a battle, you can press ESC at any time to access the menu and choose to skip the level, moving straight to the story section.

You can also skip the ending animation by pressing the button in the bottom left corner, and it will not affect your achievement collection. However, if this is your first time viewing the ending animation, we still recommend watching the endings in their entirety.

3. Function Menu Optimization

Good adventurers have to be resourceful outside of battle~

Now, the main menu can be accessed during the story session by pressing ESC. You can change the language, volume, or return to the main interface, etc., at any time through the menu.

Please note that if you change the game language while the story is ongoing, the dialogue already spoken by characters won’t change immediately— Instead, the changes will take effect and be reflected in the following conversation!

4. Interactive Guide Optimization

We’ve had a quick chat with Bea, and now she will be more astute to realize that a knock on her head can suddenly change the way she fights. How amazing!

Just so you know, Bea is safe and sound—no harm came her way in this update!

5. Other Updates

The Bread on Board Tavern has updated various art materials and corrected several textual errors in their files.

Thank you again for your support and trust, and we're excited to announce that our official X account @qiyudixiacheng is now available! Follow us for the freshest updates and share your thought in the comment!

May Hosbitome bless you!

notes.title: Day One Patch Notes
notes.notes:
Dear Adventurers, We want to extend a heartfelt thank you for your  support on the release day of our game! Now, let's address some of the questions you've been asking:


 Bug fixes: We've been hard at work fixing several bugs, including issues with the bag cover, the full ending achievement not popping up, and some naming errors in the endings. If you're still encountering similar issues, please double-check that your Build ID is 13819091 and manually update the game files by verifying integrity.

 Regarding ending determination: We understand that many of you are curious about how the endings are triggered and determined, as well as the conditions for triggering certain options. Currently, if you decide to replay Level 10 after completing the game and change your choices, the disposal option values (purification values) for all monsters from previous playthroughs will be reset (treated as if all monsters were attacked). Achieving the "recover" ending currently requires restarting the game, but please know that we're actively  optimizing this process.

 Other issues: We've also received feedback about issues like incorrect achievement pop-ups, failures to display achievements, and some level-related problems. Please rest assured that we're on it and will optimize these as quickly as possible.


Once again, thank you from the bottom of our hearts for playing our game! If you have any questions or feedback, please don't hesitate to share them in the comments. We're here to listen and improve with your help!
